answer: The cheapest real defence: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because vertex only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, jetty is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any juniper approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
